note: zizania is darnel (Lolium temulentum), a weed that looks like wheat until it heads; "tares" (vetch) is a different plant.

kjv: the harvest is the end of the world
mine: The harvest is the end of the age
note: synteleia aionos is "the consummation of the age" (also 13:40, 49; 24:3; 28:20); KJV's "world" suggests the end of the physical cosmos rather than of the present era.

kjv: his (Jesus') brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas
mine: his (Jesus') brothers James and Joseph and Simon and Judas
note: TR "Iōsēs" (from Mark 6:3) against "Iōsēph" in Sinaiticus and Vaticanus.

kjv: kept secret from the foundation of the world
note: TR adds "kosmou" ("of the world"); its absence in Sinaiticus (first hand) and others makes the shorter text likely.
